aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (mobile) in Philippines at 84.78% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari iPhone ranked second at 11.28%, followed by Chrome for iPhone at 2.32%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (mobile) in Philippines?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 84.78% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/mobile/philippines.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (mobile) in Philippines?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (84.78%), Safari iPhone (11.28%), Chrome for iPhone (2.32%) in October 2026.
